name: Machine chest press
description: Guided horizontal press on a machine; a safe way to learn pressing.
instruction: Set the seat so the handles are at mid-chest. Press forward until the arms are almost straight, then return slowly without letting the weight stack touch.

name: Cable fly
description: Standing fly between two cable pulleys; keeps tension on the chest through the whole arc.
instruction: Stand between the pulleys with a slight bend in the elbows. Bring the handles together in front of the chest in a wide arc, then open slowly until you feel a stretch.

name: Barbell bench press
description: The classic horizontal press with a barbell on a flat bench.
instruction: Lie with eyes under the bar, feet flat and shoulder blades pulled back. Lower the bar to the lower chest with control, then press it back up over the shoulders. Use a spotter or safety arms.

name: Incline barbell bench press
description: Bench press on a 30-45 degree incline; shifts the work to the upper chest.
instruction: Set the bench to 30-45 degrees. Lower the bar to the upper chest, keeping the elbows slightly tucked, then press up and slightly back. Use a spotter or safety arms.

name: Weighted dip
description: Parallel-bar dip with added weight on a dip belt; for lifters who do many clean bodyweight dips.
instruction: Hang the weight from a dip belt and support yourself on straight arms. Lean slightly forward and lower until the upper arms are parallel to the floor, then press back up.

name: Dumbbell bench press
description: Flat bench press with dumbbells; each arm works on its own.
instruction: Lie on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand above the chest. Lower them to the sides of the chest, elbows at about 45 degrees, then press up until the arms are straight.

name: Dumbbell fly
description: Isolation fly on a flat bench that stretches and squeezes the chest.
instruction: Lie on a bench with dumbbells above the chest, elbows slightly bent. Open the arms in a wide arc until you feel a stretch, then bring the dumbbells back together.

name: Incline dumbbell press
description: Dumbbell press on an incline bench for the upper chest.
instruction: Set the bench to 30-45 degrees. Press the dumbbells from the upper chest until the arms are straight, then lower them slowly to the start.

name: Deficit push-up on dumbbells
description: Push-up with the hands on dumbbells so the chest goes below hand level.
instruction: Grip two stable dumbbells on the floor shoulder-width apart. Keep the body in a straight line and lower the chest below the handles, then press back up.

name: Push-up
description: Bodyweight horizontal press; scale it by putting the hands on a raised surface.
instruction: Place the hands slightly wider than the shoulders and hold the body in a straight line. Lower the chest close to the floor, then press back up.

name: Decline push-up
description: Push-up with the feet raised on a chair; more load on the upper chest and shoulders.
instruction: Put the feet on a chair and the hands on the floor slightly wider than the shoulders. Keep the hips in line and lower the chest to the floor, then press back up.

name: Archer push-up
description: Wide push-up that shifts most of the weight onto one arm at a time.
instruction: Set the hands very wide. Lower towards one hand while the other arm straightens to the side, press back up, then alternate sides.

name: Lat pulldown
description: Vertical pull on a cable machine; builds strength for pull-ups.
instruction: Grip the bar slightly wider than the shoulders and sit with the thighs under the pads. Pull the bar to the upper chest by driving the elbows down, then let it rise slowly.

name: Seated cable row
description: Horizontal row on a cable machine with a supported torso.
instruction: Sit with the knees slightly bent and the back straight. Pull the handle to the stomach, squeezing the shoulder blades together, then extend the arms slowly.

name: Barbell row
description: Bent-over row with a barbell; a heavy horizontal pull.
instruction: Hinge at the hips with a flat back until the torso is about 45 degrees. Pull the bar to the lower ribs, then lower it with control without rounding the back.

name: Barbell deadlift
description: Lifting a barbell from the floor to standing; trains the whole posterior chain.
instruction: Stand with the bar over mid-foot and grip it just outside the legs. Brace, keep the back flat and push the floor away until standing, then lower the bar the same way.

name: Weighted pull-up
description: Pull-up with added weight on a dip belt; for lifters who do many clean bodyweight pull-ups.
instruction: Hang the weight from a dip belt and hang from the bar with straight arms. Pull until the chin is over the bar, then lower to a full hang.

name: One-arm dumbbell row
description: Single-arm row with one hand and knee supported on a bench.
instruction: Put one hand and knee on a bench and keep the back flat. Pull the dumbbell to the hip, then lower it until the arm is straight. Switch sides.

name: Pull-up
description: Vertical bodyweight pull on a bar with an overhand grip.
instruction: Hang from the bar with hands slightly wider than the shoulders. Pull until the chin is over the bar, then lower to a full hang without swinging.

name: Chin-up
description: Pull-up with an underhand grip; more work for the biceps.
instruction: Hang from the bar with palms facing you, hands shoulder-width apart. Pull until the chin is over the bar, then lower to a full hang.

name: Archer pull-up
description: Wide pull-up that shifts the weight onto one arm at a time.
instruction: Take a very wide grip. Pull towards one hand while the other arm straightens along the bar, lower, then alternate sides.

name: Inverted row under a table
description: Bodyweight row lying under a sturdy table; the easiest horizontal pull.
instruction: Lie under a sturdy table and grip its edge. Keep the body straight from heels to shoulders and pull the chest to the edge, then lower slowly. Check that the table cannot tip.

name: Door towel row
description: Row with a towel looped around a closed door's handles.
instruction: Loop a towel around both handles of a closed, locked door and hold the ends. Lean back with straight arms, then pull the chest towards the door and return slowly.

name: Feet-elevated inverted row
description: Inverted row with the feet on a chair; more of the body weight is lifted.
instruction: Lie under a sturdy table with the heels on a chair. Keep the body straight and pull the chest to the table edge, then lower slowly.

name: Single-arm inverted row
description: Inverted row pulling with one arm; resists rotation as well.
instruction: Set up as for an inverted row but hold the table edge with one hand. Pull the chest up without twisting, lower slowly, then switch arms.

name: Machine shoulder press
description: Guided overhead press on a machine.
instruction: Adjust the seat so the handles start at shoulder height. Press up until the arms are almost straight, then lower slowly.

name: Cable lateral raise
description: Single-arm side raise on a low cable; constant tension on the side delts.
instruction: Stand side-on to a low pulley and hold the handle in the far hand. Raise the arm out to the side to shoulder height, then lower slowly.

name: Face pull
description: Rope pull to the face on a high cable; trains the rear delts and upper back.
instruction: Set a rope at face height. Pull it towards the forehead, spreading the ends and turning the hands back, then return slowly.

name: Barbell overhead press
description: Standing overhead press with a barbell.
instruction: Hold the bar at the front of the shoulders and brace the trunk. Press it straight overhead, moving the head back slightly, then lower to the shoulders.

name: Push press
description: Overhead press started with a short leg drive; moves more weight than a strict press.
instruction: Hold the bar at the shoulders. Dip a few centimetres at the knees, drive up and press the bar overhead in one motion, then lower it to the shoulders.

name: Dumbbell shoulder press
description: Seated or standing overhead press with dumbbells.
instruction: Hold the dumbbells at shoulder height, palms forward. Press them overhead until the arms are straight, then lower to the start.

name: Lateral raise
description: Dumbbell side raise for the side delts.
instruction: Stand with dumbbells at your sides. Raise the arms out to shoulder height with a slight bend in the elbows, then lower slowly.

name: Dumbbell reverse fly
description: Bent-over fly for the rear delts and upper back.
instruction: Hinge forward with a flat back, dumbbells hanging below the chest. Raise the arms out to the sides, squeezing the shoulder blades, then lower slowly.

name: Arnold press
description: Dumbbell press that rotates from palms-in to palms-forward.
instruction: Start with the dumbbells in front of the shoulders, palms facing you. Press up while turning the palms forward, then reverse the movement on the way down.

name: Dumbbell Z press
description: Overhead press sitting on the floor with straight legs; no back support.
instruction: Sit on the floor with the legs straight and the back upright. Press the dumbbells overhead without leaning back, then lower to the shoulders.

name: Prone Y-raise
description: Lying face down and raising the arms in a Y shape; trains the lower traps and rear delts.
instruction: Lie face down with the arms overhead in a Y, thumbs up. Lift the arms off the floor by squeezing the shoulder blades, hold briefly, then lower.

name: Pike push-up
description: Push-up with the hips high; a bodyweight overhead press.
instruction: Start in a push-up position and walk the feet in until the hips are high. Bend the elbows to bring the head towards the floor, then press back up.

name: Wall handstand push-up
description: Handstand against a wall, lowering the head to the floor and pressing up.
instruction: Kick up into a handstand facing away from the wall. Lower the head to the floor with control, then press back up. Only try it once you can hold the handstand.

name: Cable curl
description: Biceps curl on a low cable.
instruction: Stand facing a low pulley with a bar attachment. Curl the bar to the shoulders with the elbows at your sides, then lower slowly.

name: EZ-bar curl
description: Standing curl with an angled bar that is easier on the wrists.
instruction: Hold the EZ bar on the angled grips. Curl it up without moving the elbows forward, then lower until the arms are straight.

name: Dumbbell curl
description: Standing curl with dumbbells.
instruction: Hold the dumbbells at your sides, palms forward. Curl them to the shoulders keeping the elbows still, then lower slowly.

name: Hammer curl
description: Curl with the palms facing each other; also trains the forearm.
instruction: Hold the dumbbells with the palms facing your body. Curl them up keeping that grip, then lower slowly.

name: Incline dumbbell curl
description: Curl lying back on an incline bench; stretches the biceps at the bottom.
instruction: Sit back on a bench set to about 45 degrees, arms hanging straight. Curl the dumbbells up without moving the upper arms, then lower fully.

name: Towel curl
description: Curl against your own resistance with a towel under one foot.
instruction: Hold both ends of a towel looped under one foot. Curl the towel up while pressing down with the foot to make it hard, then lower slowly.

name: Cable pushdown
description: Elbow extension on a high cable.
instruction: Hold the bar or rope at a high pulley with the elbows at your sides. Push down until the arms are straight, then let it rise slowly.

name: Close-grip bench press
description: Bench press with a shoulder-width grip; shifts the work to the triceps.
instruction: Lie on a bench and grip the bar shoulder-width apart. Lower it to the lower chest with the elbows close to the body, then press up. Use a spotter or safety arms.

name: Parallel bar dip
description: Upright dip on parallel bars.
instruction: Support yourself on straight arms with the body upright. Lower until the upper arms are parallel to the floor, then press back up.

name: Overhead dumbbell extension
description: Elbow extension with one dumbbell held overhead.
instruction: Hold one dumbbell overhead with both hands. Lower it behind the head by bending the elbows, then straighten the arms.

name: Dumbbell skull crusher
description: Lying elbow extension with dumbbells on a bench.
instruction: Lie on a bench with the dumbbells above the shoulders. Bend the elbows to lower them beside the head, then straighten the arms without moving the upper arms.

name: Chair dip
description: Dip with the hands on a sturdy chair behind you.
instruction: Sit on the edge of a stable chair, hands beside the hips, and slide forward off it. Lower until the elbows are at about 90 degrees, then press back up.

name: Diamond push-up
description: Push-up with the hands close together under the chest.
instruction: Place the hands together under the chest, thumbs and index fingers forming a diamond. Lower the chest to the hands, then press back up.

name: Leg press
description: Machine squat pattern with the back supported.
instruction: Place the feet shoulder-width on the platform. Lower it until the knees are at about 90 degrees without the lower back lifting, then press back up.

name: Leg extension
description: Machine knee extension that isolates the quadriceps.
instruction: Sit with the pad on the lower shins. Straighten the knees, pause briefly, then lower slowly.

name: Barbell back squat
description: Squat with a barbell on the upper back; the main lower-body strength lift.
instruction: Rest the bar on the upper back and brace. Sit down between the heels to at least parallel, keeping the chest up, then stand up. Use a rack with safety bars.

name: Barbell front squat
description: Squat with the bar on the front of the shoulders; demands an upright torso and mobility.
instruction: Rest the bar on the front of the shoulders with the elbows high. Squat down keeping the torso upright, then stand up. Use a rack with safety bars.

name: Goblet squat
description: Squat holding one dumbbell at the chest; the easiest loaded squat to learn.
instruction: Hold a dumbbell vertically at the chest. Squat down between the heels keeping the chest up, then stand up.

name: Dumbbell step-up
description: Stepping onto a bench with dumbbells in the hands.
instruction: Hold the dumbbells at your sides and place one foot on a bench. Drive through that foot to stand on the bench, step down with control, then switch legs.

name: Bulgarian split squat
description: Split squat with the rear foot on a bench.
instruction: Stand in front of a bench with the rear foot on it. Lower the back knee towards the floor keeping the front knee over the foot, then press up through the front leg.

name: Front-foot-elevated dumbbell split squat
description: Split squat with the front foot on a low step; a deeper range under load.
instruction: Hold the dumbbells and put the front foot on a low step. Lower the back knee as far as control allows, then press up. Switch legs.

name: Bodyweight squat
description: Air squat; the basic squat pattern.
instruction: Stand with the feet shoulder-width apart. Sit down between the heels with the chest up, then stand up.

name: Reverse lunge
description: Stepping back into a lunge; easier on the knees than a forward lunge.
instruction: Step one foot back and lower the back knee towards the floor. Push through the front foot to return to standing, then switch legs.

name: Jump squat
description: Squat followed by an explosive jump.
instruction: Squat to about parallel, then jump as high as you can. Land softly with bent knees and go straight into the next rep.

name: Pistol squat
description: Single-leg squat with the other leg held forward.
instruction: Stand on one leg with the other held in front. Squat down as low as control allows, then stand up. Switch legs.

name: Lying leg curl
description: Machine knee curl lying face down.
instruction: Lie face down with the pad above the heels. Curl the heels towards the glutes, then lower slowly.

name: Seated leg curl
description: Machine knee curl in a seated position.
instruction: Sit with the pad behind the lower legs and the thigh pad locked. Curl the legs down and back, then return slowly.

name: Barbell Romanian deadlift
description: Hip hinge with a barbell that stretches and loads the hamstrings.
instruction: Hold the bar at the hips with soft knees. Push the hips back and lower the bar along the legs until you feel a strong stretch, keeping the back flat, then stand up.

name: Good morning
description: Hip hinge with a barbell on the upper back.
instruction: Rest the bar on the upper back with soft knees. Push the hips back and lower the torso towards parallel with a flat back, then stand up. Start light.

name: Dumbbell Romanian deadlift
description: Hip hinge with dumbbells.
instruction: Hold the dumbbells in front of the thighs. Push the hips back and lower them along the legs with a flat back until you feel a stretch, then stand up.

name: Dumbbell lying leg curl
description: Knee curl lying face down on a bench with a dumbbell between the feet.
instruction: Lie face down on a bench with a dumbbell held securely between the feet. Curl it towards the glutes, then lower slowly.

name: Single-leg dumbbell Romanian deadlift
description: Romanian deadlift on one leg; adds balance and hip control.
instruction: Hold a dumbbell in the hand opposite the standing leg. Hinge forward while the free leg extends behind, keeping the hips square, then stand up. Switch legs.

name: Single-leg hip hinge
description: Bodyweight single-leg Romanian deadlift.
instruction: Stand on one leg with a soft knee. Hinge forward as the free leg extends behind until the torso is near parallel, then stand up. Switch legs.

name: Sliding leg curl
description: Hamstring curl lying on your back with the heels on a towel on a smooth floor.
instruction: Lie on your back with the heels on a towel and lift the hips. Slide the heels out until the legs are almost straight, then curl them back in, keeping the hips up.

name: Nordic curl
description: Kneeling hamstring curl with the heels anchored; very demanding eccentric work.
instruction: Kneel with the heels anchored under a heavy sofa or held by a partner. Lower the body forward as slowly as possible with straight hips, catch yourself with the hands, then push back up.

name: Cable kickback
description: Hip extension on a low cable with an ankle strap.
instruction: Attach the strap to one ankle and hold the machine. Kick the leg back by squeezing the glute, without arching the lower back, then return slowly.

name: Barbell hip thrust
description: Hip extension with a barbell across the hips and the upper back on a bench.
instruction: Sit with the upper back against a bench and the bar padded over the hips. Drive the hips up until the body is flat from knees to shoulders, then lower.

name: Barbell walking lunge
description: Walking lunges with a barbell on the upper back; demands balance under load.
instruction: Rest the bar on the upper back. Take a long step forward and lower the back knee towards the floor, then step through into the next lunge.

name: Dumbbell hip thrust
description: Hip thrust with a dumbbell on the hips and the upper back on a bench.
instruction: Sit with the upper back against a bench and a dumbbell on the hips. Drive the hips up until the body is flat from knees to shoulders, then lower.

name: Single-leg bench hip thrust
description: Bodyweight hip thrust on one leg with the upper back on a bench.
instruction: Rest the upper back on a bench, one foot on the floor and the other leg raised. Drive the hips up through the planted foot, then lower. Switch legs.

name: Single-leg dumbbell hip thrust
description: Single-leg hip thrust holding a dumbbell on the working hip.
instruction: Set up as for a single-leg hip thrust with a dumbbell held on the working hip. Drive the hips up, then lower. Switch legs.

name: Glute bridge
description: Hip lift lying on your back.
instruction: Lie on your back with the knees bent and the feet flat. Lift the hips until the body is straight from knees to shoulders, squeeze the glutes, then lower.

name: Single-leg glute bridge
description: Glute bridge on one leg.
instruction: Lie on your back with one foot flat and the other leg raised. Lift the hips through the planted foot without letting them tilt, then lower. Switch legs.

name: Skater squat
description: Single-leg squat lowering the rear knee towards the floor.
instruction: Stand on one leg with the other knee bent behind. Squat down until the rear knee nearly touches the floor, leaning slightly forward, then stand up. Switch legs.

name: Seated calf raise machine
description: Seated calf raise on a machine; targets the soleus.
instruction: Sit with the pad on the lower thighs and the balls of the feet on the platform. Raise the heels as high as possible, then lower them below the platform.

name: Standing calf raise machine
description: Standing calf raise on a machine with straight knees.
instruction: Stand with the shoulders under the pads and the balls of the feet on the edge. Rise onto the toes, then lower the heels below the edge.

name: Single-leg dumbbell calf raise
description: Calf raise on one leg holding a dumbbell.
instruction: Stand on one foot on a step, holding a dumbbell and a support. Rise onto the toes, then lower the heel below the step. Switch legs.

name: Standing calf raise
description: Bodyweight calf raise on both feet.
instruction: Stand with the balls of the feet on a step and hold a wall. Rise onto the toes, then lower the heels below the step.

name: Single-leg calf raise
description: Bodyweight calf raise on one leg.
instruction: Stand on one foot on a step and hold a wall. Rise onto the toes, then lower the heel below the step. Switch legs.

name: Cable crunch
description: Kneeling crunch against a high cable.
instruction: Kneel facing a high pulley holding a rope beside the head. Curl the trunk down, bringing the elbows towards the thighs, then return slowly.

name: Cable woodchop
description: Diagonal rotation against a cable; trains the obliques.
instruction: Stand side-on to a high pulley and hold the handle with both hands. Pull it diagonally down across the body, rotating through the trunk, then return slowly. Switch sides.

name: Landmine rotation
description: Rotating a barbell anchored at one end from hip to hip.
instruction: Hold the free end of a landmine barbell at arm's length. Rotate it from one hip to the other in an arc, turning the trunk and pivoting the feet.

name: Bench reverse crunch
description: Lifting the hips off a bench by curling the knees to the chest.
instruction: Lie on a bench holding its end behind the head, knees bent. Curl the knees towards the chest so the hips lift, then lower slowly.

name: Hanging knee raise
description: Raising the knees while hanging from a pull-up bar.
instruction: Hang from the bar with straight arms. Raise the knees towards the chest without swinging, then lower slowly.

name: Ab wheel rollout
description: Rolling an ab wheel forward from the knees; strong anti-extension work.
instruction: Kneel holding an ab wheel under the shoulders. Roll forward as far as you can without the lower back sagging, then pull back to the start.

name: Dead bug
description: Lying on your back and extending opposite arm and leg; teaches bracing.
instruction: Lie on your back with the arms up and the knees over the hips. Lower the opposite arm and leg towards the floor keeping the lower back flat, return, then switch sides.

name: Bird dog
description: Extending opposite arm and leg on hands and knees.
instruction: Kneel on all fours. Extend one arm and the opposite leg without rotating the hips, hold briefly, return, then switch sides.

name: V-up
description: Lifting the legs and the torso together to touch the toes.
instruction: Lie on your back with the arms overhead. Lift the straight legs and the torso together and reach for the toes, then lower with control.

name: Towel ab rollout
description: Rollout from the knees with the hands on a towel on a smooth floor.
instruction: Kneel with the hands on a towel on a smooth floor. Slide forward as far as you can without the lower back sagging, then pull back to the start.
